messages:
Ashley: Quick heads-up — EdgeCloud signed the MOU and asked for a joint POC next week to validate low-latency inference in EU. They want an architecture sketch, SSO flow, answers to the security questionnaire, and a POC pricing plan. Can SEs + security triage? @mike @jordan @priya @samir
Mike: I can lead the SE side. Two quick clarifiers: do they want Redwood Dedicated in their VPC, or a Hosted API routed to EU with dedicated capacity? That choice changes networking + timeline.
Jordan: If they want Dedicated in their VPC we’ll need VPC peering or PrivateLink + specific egress rules. I have a draft topology — uploading in drive now: https://drive.redwood/edgecloud/arch-v1.png
Samir: Sales side — they asked for consumption vs committed pricing for a 6-week POC ~10k reqs/day. What’s our suggested POC pricing and any standard discount for partner joint POCs? Also they require SSO and tenant isolation.
Priya: I’ll take the security questionnaire. Can someone add the EdgeCloud contact and paste the questionnaire link here? Also we need to confirm if they require customer-managed KMS/HSM for encryption at rest. If yes, that’s a non-starter for Hosted without Private.
Matt: Network notes from infra: if peering, allow these outbound CIDRs and ports on their side:
```
Allowed CIDRs: 10.12.0.0/16, 172.20.0.0/16
Ports: tcp/443, tcp/8443 (control plane), udp/3478 (STUN)
TLS: mutual TLS optional for control plane
```
Mike: For speed of delivery I recommend Hosted API with dedicated routing to our EU cluster for the initial POC. It avoids customer infra changes and we can demo latency. If they insist on VPC deployment, add ~2-3 weeks. Samir — propose a flat POC fee + committed discount if they convert.
Samir: Sounds good. Draft POC pricing: flat $15k for 6 weeks (includes support + up to 10k reqs/day), then convert to standard committed pricing. @Ashley want me to propose that?
Ashley: Yes please propose that as a starting point. I’ll label it "EdgeCloud joint POC — initial ask".
Priya: Also: set data retention to ephemeral for the POC and disable model telemetry collection unless they opt in. We'll include that in the questionnaire responses.
Mike: Enablement ask — I’ll run a 60m technical workshop during week 1 (model ops, prompts, perf tuning). Jordan, can you prepare a runbook for failover and rollback?
Jordan: On it. I’ll include quantization/latency benchmarks and a short checklist for routing fallback to a smaller model if capacity hits.
Marie: @Ashley @Mike thanks, EdgeCloud here. We prefer Dedicated nodes in our VPC for compliance reasons. We’ll share the security questionnaire and a short infra doc by EOD. Also happy to join Wed kick-off.
Ashley: Great — scheduling kick-off Wed 10:00 CET. @calendar-bot create event and include: participants (EdgeCloud tech team), agenda (arch review, security Qs, POC scope, timeline), and pre-read link to the draft arch.
calendar-bot: Event created — "EdgeCloud x Redwood POC kick-off" Wed 10:00 CET. Invitees: Ashley, Mike, Jordan, Samir, Priya, Matt, Marie.
Samir: I'll send the proposed POC quote and draft MSA addendum after the kick-off.
Priya: One more security note — if they want HSM, we need to route to Private deployment and get legal sign-off. Flagging as an enterprise blocker for Hosted.
Mike: Ack. For the POC plan I'll prepare both paths (Hosted quick path + VPC Dedicated path) so we can pivot.
Ashley: Perfect. Action items: Mike — SE plan + workshop. Jordan — runbook + arch update. Priya — questionnaire answers. Matt — network rules + peering checklist. Samir — POC pricing draft. Marie — EdgeCloud infra doc + questionnaire. Meeting invite sent. :thumbsup:
